opening.argument: The presentation directs viewers to fund a Trust wallet, approve an Ethereum transaction, and purchase additional Forsage slots. It then ties activating more slots to earning faster, urges viewers to activate all slots as soon as possible, and presents purchased slots and cycling matrices as repeatedly generating income. The opportunity is therefore structured around paid, tiered participation and team-linked earnings, not a simple product demonstration. Although an approximately 80-Ethereum example is expressly not guaranteed, that qualification does not alter the promotion of recurring income through slot activation and matrices. The separate Crypto.com promotion does not appear to be part of the Forsage interface.
